en: Huh? You followed me all the way in here? Stay back! Don't come any closer!
Grr... What a dead end! Whoever dug this tunnel gave up halfway. And now I'm stuck with you!
Fine! If it's a battle you want, it's a battle you'll get!
Ugh, I lost? This job was supposed to be easy!
Take your stupid parts, then! I was told to grab them, not to fight kids over them!
Team Aqua won't forget this. Out of my way!
Peeko! Oh, my dear Peeko, you're safe! I was so worried about you!
And you got her back for me? Thank you, thank you! I'm Briney. I live in the cottage on Route 104's beach.
If ever there's anything I can do for you, come and see me. I'll never forget this!
Wanda! Can you hear me? I'll dig through to you, I promise! Nothing's going to keep us apart!
Oh, sorry. Wanda's my girlfriend. She's just on the other side of these rocks, but they're too hard to move.
If only someone had a Pokémon strong enough to smash them...
Is somebody there? My cousin Wally is coming to stay with us in Verdanturf. I hope this tunnel is open by then!
